disposition_rationale: Under the inherited FTK-0 freeze, the representation under test is continuous inventory economic-level lag-1 delta plus continuous margin M1 state (not sign-only soup). R1–R8 pass as structural SNR preflight without material trial debit. Sign remains the inventory decision emission but continuous magnitude is retained for sensing. No within-freeze repair required before L4 charged-slice freeze recommendation. Passing L3 does not authorize L5.
